page.overview:
What is Bonnie the Rabbit?

Bonnie the Rabbit is a minor recurring character in the Tales from the Pizzaplex series and is one of the main mascots of the Freddy Fazbear's Pizza family entertainment restaurant chain.

Bonnie is a large purple animatronic rabbit with lighter highlights on his ears, stomach, paws, and muzzle. He has a red bowtie and carries a red guitar. In the graphic novel adaption of Pressure, Bonnie is shown to be a blue rabbit with white highlights and red eyes.

Bonnie, along with Freddy and Chica, appears in the Freddy and Friends cartoon TV show that Billy watches.

Bonnie appears as, what Luca thinks is, a statue in Urban Legends Role Play Auditorium.
